units.source_text: 我开始暗暗可怜起了一无所知的母亲。

en.t: I began to feel a quiet pity for my mother, who knew nothing.

units.source_text: 但是，我不能理解母亲为什么偏偏在这样乱糟糟的时候提出这种问题。

en.t: But I could not understand why my mother would bring up such a question at such a confused time.

units.source_text: 正如我竟然还有时间静静地读书，而把父亲的病放在一旁一样，我怀疑母亲恐怕心中也有着令她暂时忘却眼前的病人，思考别的事情的空隙吧。

en.t: Just as I somehow still had time to read quietly while setting my father's illness aside, I wondered whether my mother too might have some space in her heart that let her forget the sick man before her for a while and think about other things.

units.source_text: “实际上，我是想，你要是能在你爸活着的时候找到工作，他也就放心了。

en.t: "Actually, I was thinking that if you could find a job while your father is still alive, it would put his mind at ease.

units.source_text: 可是看这情形，他怕是看不到了。

en.t: But judging from how things look, he may not live to see it.

units.source_text: 不过，他现在又能吃，脑袋也清醒，趁着这个时候，设法让他高兴高兴，尽尽你的孝心吧。”

en.t: Still, he can eat now, and his mind is clear, so while you have the chance, try to make him happy and do your duty as a son."

units.source_text: 然而，可怜的我的处境却不能尽这份孝心，终于连一行字也没有给先生写。

en.t: Yet in my unfortunate circumstances I could not perform that filial duty, and in the end I did not write even a single line to Sensei.
